explanation: On the corrected domain s>0, g(t)=(1-e^{-3t})/3, so its Laplace transform is (1/3)(1/s-1/(s+3))=1/[s(s+3)]. Option a is therefore valid. The original domain s>-3 is erroneous because the transform diverges for -3<s≤0.
